recognition.note: 확인한 컴퓨터 분야 기준에서 이 후보의 일괄 불인정 조항은 확인되지 않았다. 국립경국대·경북대의 실제 인정은 최신 모집 분야, 논문 유형, 전공 관련성, 저자 역할과 게재 완료 여부에 따라 확인해야 하며 경북대 최신 세부 기준은 미확인이다.

venues.name: IEEE Software
venues.scope: Software engineering practice, architecture, development, maintenance and practitioner education.
venues.contribution_expectation: Transfer a supported software engineering insight into decisions practitioners can apply, with explicit costs and limits.
venues.analysis_expectation: Trace concrete design choices and alternatives to retained sources, compare prior work and explain when each lesson holds or fails.

venues.name: IEEE Security & Privacy
venues.scope: Security and privacy knowledge that engineers and practitioners can apply to real systems.
venues.contribution_expectation: Explain a consequential security or privacy problem and actionable design implications for a broad technical readership.
venues.analysis_expectation: Retain a concrete threat model, authority or trust-boundary analysis, alternatives and conditional limitations. Never claim measured exploit resistance or deployment outcomes without evidence.
